sections.visualStyle: light grey background (secondary-section), spacious top-of-page intro
sections.overview: Page hero/intro: large headline, supporting paragraph, two call-to-action buttons on the left; a stacked collage of three lifestyle photos on the right.

sequences.description: Large heading 'Fresh looks, bold stories, real life', descriptive subheading paragraph, and two buttons ('See case' primary, 'All stories' secondary), displayed alongside a group of three cover images (hip-hop dance, family vacation, music concert).

sections.overview: Featured case-study teaser: a large landscape cover image beside breadcrumbs, an H2 heading, and author byline metadata (author name, date, read time).

sequences.description: Side-by-side layout: a landscape cover image (adventure spots) in one column; in the other column a breadcrumb trail (Home > Case studies), heading 'Fresh looks, bold moves, real stories', and author meta line 'By Taylor Brooks / June 12, 2024 • 4 min read'.

sections.overview: Photo gallery 'Style in every snapshot': centered heading and subheading, followed by a uniform 8-image grid (4 columns x 2 rows) of lifestyle photos with no captions.

sequences.description: Centered heading 'Style in every snapshot' with subheading paragraph 'Peek the latest looks in action'.
Uniform grid of 8 square lifestyle images (hip-hop dance, beach, concert crowd, campus life, gaming, mobile game, fashion inspiration, campus tour), no text/captions.

sections.layout: tabbed interface (content panel + tab menu row of 4)
sections.overview: Testimonials presented as a tabbed interface: four selectable people tabs (avatar + name + role), each revealing a panel with a large portrait image, name, role, and a quote.

sequences.description: Tabbed testimonial switcher with four tabs (Alex Rivera / Streetwear Enthusiast, Taylor Kim / Casual Style Blogger, Jordan Ellis / Trend Spotter, Morgan Blake / Party Scene Curator). Each active tab shows a portrait image plus the person's name, role, and a testimonial quote.

sections.overview: 'Latest articles' section: centered heading and subheading, followed by four article cards, each with an image, a category tag + date meta row, and an article title. Each card is a link.

sequences.description: Centered heading 'Latest articles' with subheading paragraph 'Fresh looks, bold moves'.
Grid of 4 article cards; each card = image + category tag (e.g. 'Casual Cool') + date (e.g. 'May 12') + article title heading (e.g. 'Tennis style, redefined'). Whole card is a link.

sections.overview: FAQ section: heading 'Got questions? We've got answers.' with a subheading on one side; an expandable list of four question/answer items (details/summary) on the other.

sequences.description: Heading 'Got questions? We've got answers.' with subheading 'Fashion FAQs, answered fast'.
Expandable FAQ list of 4 collapsible question/answer pairs (How do I spot the latest trends?; Can I share my own outfit pics?; Where do you find your style inspo?; How can I join your community?).

sections.visualStyle: dark background (inverse-section) with full-bleed background photo + dark overlay
sections.overview: Closing call-to-action banner: full-width background photograph with a dark overlay, large white headline 'Fresh looks, bold stories, real life', descriptive subheading, and a single 'See more' button.

sequences.description: Full-bleed background image (networking event) with dark overlay; white heading 'Fresh looks, bold stories, real life', a longer descriptive subheading about the case study, and one CTA button 'See more'.
